notes.title: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks 1.0 Launches on Steam
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that our publisher Wired Productions and developer Caged Element have officially launched Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks on Steam today. Following an early access phase that saw over 250,000 players blast opponents, this high-octane combat racing game has had some tuning up and has sped into 1.0. 

Last week, Wired Productions revealed they had taken over publishing rights – removing microtransactions entirely - and introducing fresh tracks, maps, game modes, and customization options. Assemble your crew of Grotz, Gitz, and Squigz – and battle in PVP and PVE lobbies! 

Visit the Warhammer site for more details and stay tuned for insights into the game's next explosive chapter, as Wired Productions continues its partnership with Caged Element, the original publisher of 2018’s acclaimed GRIP: Combat Racing. Embrace the chaos, ignite the battles, and experience the thrill of Speed Freeks like never before.

Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks is available now on Steam at a special discounted price of just $15.99, €15.99 and £12.79.  

New content includes:  

 Player-hosted games: Create private or public lobbies with custom settings.  
 New Vehicle – Trukk: A havoc-wreaking ambush vehicle with a fearsome amount of firepower and rowdy orks in the back.  
 New Game Mode - Free Roam: Choose any map and create custom races around it, as well as practice driving skills and abilities.  
 New Maps: Da Dust Up and Da Gorge are Speed Freeks’ most dynamic and visually striking to date.  
 Ork Pit Bosses: Players can now unlock and customize Ork avatars to show off to teammates and enemies alike.  
 Alternative Weapons: Unlockable weapons expand the playstyles of each vehicle for new ways to master them.

notes.title: Free Filter Mode Update Out Now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/920f110cedf0ec1183ab202ef21aef35b7ead4e8.jpg

Hello agents. 

Today Leviathan wants to share several important bits of news with you - please move your allocated 10 minutes of scheduled work break to a period of time that allows you to digest the announcements.

Filter Mode Update

This update brings six unique visual filters you can toggle on the fly to change the mood, tone, and overall atmosphere of the game. Want to lean into that grainy retro horror feel? Go with 8MM Film or Old Film. Feeling surreal? Try Dreamcore or Fisheye. Craving something more subdued or haunting? Low Saturation and the new Nori-inspired Black and White filter will absolutely dial things up.

We loved messing around with these ourselves. It’s a great way to re-experience some of KARMA’s most intense moments with a whole new vibe.
Are you ready to step back into the darkness and uncover the secrets that lurk in the shadows of your mind?

[previewyoutube=mvyUs4oa-kU;full][/previewyoutube]

20% Discount

To celebrate the new update, we've also put a special week long 20% discount on KARMA - starting RIGHT NOW and running until Monday 19th 6pm BST.

To mark the update (and because we're celebrating our birthday all month), we're offering 20% off for new players on Steam for a limited time. That brings the game down to just $19.99 / £15.99, and it’s the perfect excuse to finally check it out, or recommend it to a friend ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1376200/KARMA_The_Dark_World/

Steamdeck Verification

Leviathan is also pleased to announce that KARMA has been awarded SteamDeck verified status! Agents who prefer to perform their investigations on SteamDeck can enjoy the full suite of features on the go.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/aea7f3184ed8b8d7d72b3adf17e1fabc6903f223.jpg

The Filter Mode Update is not the only post launch feature being added to the game, we've been collecting your thoughts, suggestions and feedback since launch - so standby for further bug fixes and announcements in the near future.

Thanks for all your support. We can’t wait to hear what you think of the new filters. Tag us in your weirdest, wildest screenshots. Let’s see what kind of madness you can create!

Until next time.

notes.title: Early Reviews Roundup
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/41cdaf55dc82d564e18a1c511021e298ea6e790d.png

Good afternoon Agents 

As mentioned in yesterdays blog, a HUGE thank you to all of you for playing a part in making Pollards first game, Wired's biggest day one launch EVER. It means so so much to everyone involved.

We wanted to share a few of the reviews that have been put out in the wild to let people who may still be on the fence read the opinions of folks (and of course let people who've already played see how close they match up with their own!) But before that, a little housekeeping.

Upcoming patch

Thanks to everyone who's been submitting bugs and issues, we've been replying, tracking, and finding workarounds as quickly as timezones allow. We are testing a patch that we hope to deploy at the start of the week to fix the immediate issues - and will keep you updated once it's live. In the meantime, We're updating the FAQ post with any current workarounds - so take a look there before new submissions, if it's not listed, feel free to submit!

Upcoming Features

We teased it a bit yesterday, but we have some exciting feature updates to come that we'll be talking about soon. We're also taking note of ALL your suggestions in the steam forums and discussions (photo mode requests, key binding and the ability to skip cutscenes on a second playthrough for achievement hunters for example) and talking with the developers about what we can support and when. So PLEASE if you have an idea you think would be neat, or simply some feedback - don't be quiet about it - we see it all!

Please leave a review <3

Whilst we're about to share some of the press thoughts and opinions here - which are important for people NOT aware of the game to learn about it - the reviews we really care about are YOURS, the good AND the bad.

Good reviews help the visibility of the game on Steam and help other gamers make better purchasing decisions with their hard earned cash. Bad reviews help us identify where improvements need to be made if you REALLY didn't vibe with the game - and to therefore make updates that are better for EVERYONE (all we ask is that if it is a negative review you are clear about what it was that didn't sit well with you so we can take steps to potentially rectify it for you :D )

Whilst we've made noise about this being our biggest launch ever - we are an indie publisher, and Pollard are an indie team launching their first game. Every review, every comment, every purchase, every wishlist, every trailer share, every screenshot, every stream is vital - they all add up to the visibility that makes a difference between someone else deciding to try the game or not, so for those that have done any of the above - thank you. For those that haven't, consider reviewing or sharing the game with your friends or favourite streamers - it is worth its weight in gold. 

What are the press saying? 

Gamingbolt

https://gamingbolt.com/karma-the-dark-world-review-what-are-memories

Karma: The Dark World is ultimately an interesting experience. It’s the rare horror game where, while you’re not killing things and counting bullets by the buckets, you’re also not focused entirely on hiding... Pair that with some deliciously-thick atmosphere courtesy of excellent visuals and audio, as well as an intriguing story that’s being told in a compelling way, and you get a horror experience that is well worth your time.

New York Times

https://www.nytimes.com/2025/03/28/arts/karma-dark-world-expelled-centum-review.html

"The brilliant Karma: The Dark World is one of the most aggressively disturbing horror games released in some time. Throughout 12 hours of gameplay, Karma’s creators have taken many inspirations — including BioShock and “Severance” — to the next level with creepily surreal and bizarrely utopian set pieces. Here, the looping terror of Guillermo del Toro’s and Hideo Kojima’s P.T."

PcGames.de

https://www.pcgames.de/KARMA-The-Dark-World-Spiel-75140/Tests/Der-Psycho-Thriller-ist-mein-absoluter-Ueberraschungs-Hit-des-Jahres-1469093/

Karma is a story about philosophy, religion, and culture, about the essence of humanity. Finally, I'd like to leave you with something unrelated to the game itself, but something you should return to after experiencing it for yourself

Game8

https://game8.co/articles/reviews/karma-the-dark-world-review

if you appreciate games that challenge perception, twist reality, and leave you questioning everything, then KARMA: The Dark World is a journey worth taking.

Gamingbible 

https://www.gamingbible.com/reviews/karma-the-dark-world-review-954650-20250326

KARMA: The Dark World is one hell of an enjoyable experience thanks to its stunning graphics, meaningful visuals, and gripping narrative. You will never know what’s coming next or where the story will take you but you are guaranteed to be in for a wild ride with a few jumps along the way.

There's plenty more out there for you to sink your teeth into, but for now we'll leave it there and get back to reading your own reviews - and we recommend everyone else does the same.

Don't forget you can save 10% on KARMA until April 10th - and we still have competitions running all the way til the end of the month (with even more to be announced that we'll share soon)

Thank you all once more for joining us in our Dark World, and have a wonderful weekend.

notes.title: KARMA: The Dark World IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/41cdaf55dc82d564e18a1c511021e298ea6e790d.png

Hello Agents, horror fans, mind-benders, and those who just like a good psychological trip – it’s time. KARMA: The Dark World is officially out now on PC and PlayStation 5, ready to twist your brain, haunt your thoughts, and make you question everything you thought you knew.

Before we start the celebrations - thank you all SO much for joining us on the journey since we announced our partnership with Pollard early last year. It has been wonderful to see people enjoying the trailers - solving our ARG, asking questions about the characters and story - and giving feedback on our demo. It has been a long, tiring but exciting time as we've ramped up to launch - and we couldn't do it without you.

Watch Our Epic Launch Trailer

We'd like to share our launch trailer with you - for one final glimpse into our Dark World and the characters within, before you step into Daniel's shoes.

[previewyoutube=hNH-gh7FVMM;full][/previewyoutube]

If you’re a fan of David Lynch (Twin Peaks), Hideo Kojima (Metal Gear Solid, Death Stranding), or Christopher Nolan (Inception, Interstellar), then KARMA has something for you. It’s a mind-dive into psychological horror with cinematic storytelling that’ll send shivers down your spine. This isn’t just a game – it’s an experience.

Brought to you by the brilliant minds at Pollard Studio, KARMA isn’t just another spooky game. This is psychological horror dialled up to eleven, blending brain-melting mystery with stunning Unreal Engine 5 visuals and a story that takes you through surreal landscapes, exploring themes of philosophy, love, loss and control.

Launch Day Competitions

We have a host of competitions that are live RIGHT NOW that you might be interested in! We'll be adding many more over the coming days so keep your eyes peeled to the news updates (spoilers, We have a console with enough hands to play itself...)

1. First up, we have a hacked security camera monitoring a Leviathan office on our store page :

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1376200/KARMA_The_Dark_World/

You can monitor Leviathan staff coming and going - and might spot some game keys in there to get copies for free, as well as codes for free KARMA Merch from the Wired Store.

2. We also have a Lenovo Legion Go on offer with our friends at PcGamesN if you want to ROAM as an Agent (sorry, little Leviathan Humour there) 

Check out their article on the game and enter here! : Lenovo competition 

3. Finally, we have created the aforementioned Bundles with our friends at Secret Mode with Still Wakes the Deep - you can enter a competition where 5 of you could win both games! Enter here : Still Wakes The Deep competition.

Did you say Bundles?

Yup! we’ve created two of the best bundles we could think of, thanks to two amazing friends…. You can grab KARMA: The Dark World and either INDIKA or STILL WAKES THE DEEP and save money! Two nightmares. Two great deals!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/e0970be1fa3e7950e8b0d210ae89ba5a0f9f519d.png

If you're unsure, have a look at our Steam publisher page and check our range of games : CLICK HERE TO SEE ALL OUR GAMES!

KARMA: The Dark World isn’t here to hold your hand. It’s unsettling, it’s weird, it’s intense – and that’s exactly why you need to play it. Step inside, embrace the darkness, and see if you can handle the truth.

I Need Help!

Finally, we'd like to point you where to go if you find yourself stuck, having tech issues, or just wanting to leave feedback.

Of course if you find yourself needing any assistance, you can always post on the Steam forums. But we'd ask you make sure you peep the FAQ PINNED post which contains all known issues, progress updates on bugs and more - you might find your issue is already known and any workarounds whilst patches are made can be found there : FAQ AND KNOWN ISSUES

notes.title: The Countdown Begins...
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/371585a3aa850e49d098e13874fbac9b69cf4b9e.jpg

Hello everyone!

It's a huge week for everyone here - as we are 24 HOURS away from launch!

We've got some exciting things to share with you in this update - but before we get to it we also have a little bit of housekeeping.

Update your Game!

As mentioned yesterday we've been tracking frequently mentioned bugs and issues across your demo playtime. We have just pushed an update out that should fix all the serious offenders such as :

- HDR issues and blackscreens
- Crashing
- Video issues during playback scenes
- Many other smaller issues.

For those of you still rocking through the clerical lifestyle in our demo before launch, please make sure your build is fully updated for the smoothest experience, and once again thank you all for your reports.

On launch day we will have an FAQ available listing any ongoing and reported bugs, as well as any workarounds or solutions for folks to check before submitting anything new. We'll link to it on our launch day blog so eyes peeled!

WHEN CAN I PLAY?!

KARMA will be launching on March 27th at Mid-day GMT on Steam, and at midnight local time for those playing on PlayStation 5. We have this handy Leviathan approved global time map for you to see exactly when you'll be able to enrol as a ROAM agent this Thursday.

Unfamiliar with them? Here's a quick run down :

INDIKA is a third-person, story-driven game set in alternative Russia at the turn of the XIX century where religious visions clash with harsh reality. INDIKA tells the story of a young nun who sets off on a journey of self-discovery with the most unusual companion by her side, the devil himself - one for fans of games that break traditional conventions with mechanics and presentation interwoven expertly to tell a story.

Still Wakes The Deep places you in 1975 where disaster strikes the Beira D oil rig off the coast of Scotland. notes.title: Introducing the cast of Karma
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/e8bdce4edfcae26360a22b3629e06eeb76bf6b5d.png

Hello agents - we hope you've been enjoying all the updates this week - between the previews and streams of the early hours of the game - you may have spotted a few characters in our Dark World...

We thought we'd take a moment to share some information on the citizens of our city and the information we have on them so you're better prepared to investigate them. When every shadow hides a secret knowing who you can trust is vital..

We'll also be sharing some concept art as well so you can see how they came to life from their original designs.

The cast of Karma

Daniel Mcgovern

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/a6e9958015e9958fe3e714ab862976dcf7e79095.jpg

Daniel McGovern is a ROAM Agent for Leviathan Corporation. His duties involve investigating crime scenes, interrogating suspects and witnesses, and as a last resort – performing dives into the memories of citizens to live out their history. ​

Daniel is an intelligent man, with a past he keeps close to himself. He is fiercely loyal to Leviathan, and is often described as 'cold'.​

Sean Mehndez

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/e45f665743d20339a90e29676ffef544cfd8eb37.jpg

An employee of Leviathan who lost his leg in an accident – and his since been demoted. He is a very weak and cowardly person. but he is also a father and he loves his daughter very, very deeply. 

He is an employee of Leviathan but is under investigation himself for theft, though he protests his innocence. The circumstances surrounding this theft are very much the subject of rumour and confusion - leading to the need for ROAM to be called in to investigate.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/35e02527b6e4414c38eb11ac8d520033d78978ca.jpg

Fred Ebert

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/a041693e860df7ab2a8c56f7a5775d921eb6f9c0.jpg

Fred is the head of the Winston Research Institute and a brilliant, ambitious, yet flawed man. He has experience in science and has enjoyed great admiration from his peers for the creation of technologies needed for Leviathan and used to further their goals. But at the same time, he has a strong desire for social class and always wants to climb up for a higher level.

The alleged theft from one of his clerks is an unwanted distraction for him - as is the presence of ROAM agents investigating his institute.

He is prone to moments of self import and always likes to feel one step 'above' everyone else in the room, constantly reminding others of his importance. is very rarely seen without a cigar.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/47beae8eb09d151adec5250ef1838b6e26a8dc4c.jpg

There are many other characters that we have yet to show in trailers, streams or previews - agents of the Thought Bureau with screens for faces, creatures in the shadows that may well be figments of shattered memories, scientists, families and a population caught in the collateral of something they can't comprehend. 

We'll share more about them in due time  - but for now, thank you for reading, if you like what you see, please don't forget to wishlist and share with your friends! 

We'll speak again soon. The gates to Utopia are open to those who serve

The Demo for KARMA: THE DARK WORLD is Now Live at Steam Next Fest!

The time has come! We’re thrilled to announce that the demo for KARMA: THE DARK WORLD is now live and ready to play as part of Steam Next Fest. This is your first opportunity to dive into the intricate, mysterious story Pollard Studios have crafted, all built in stunning detail with the power of Unreal Engine 5.

In the demo, you will step into the shoes of Daniel McGovern, an agent working for Leviathan Corp’s Thought Bureau. Your mission? To perform a mind dive into a suspect and uncover the truth hidden within their psyche. But it’s not just any investigation—what you discover may challenge everything you believe.

Inspired by the mind-bending work of David Lynch’s Twin Peaks and the narrative brilliance of creators like Hideo Kojima,KARMA: THE DARK WORLDblends psychological horror with a deep and personal story. As you explore, you’ll question the world around you: Who do you really work for? How much of your time do you give to your job? And how much of your life does your government control?

While the game carries chilling horror elements, there’s much more lying beneath the surface. The demo offers a first glimpse into this complex narrative, where fear and psychological tension merge with a thought-provoking journey into the darkest corners of the mind.

Play the Demo Now

Are you ready to dive into the unknown? Experience the demo for KARMA: THE DARK WORLD and start uncovering the mysteries hidden within Leviathan Corp. Who will you trust? What will you uncover?

notes.title: Karma: The Dark World Is Coming To Next Fest!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/6a00c15a3553aaaabe1555b587ad9002ef7decd4.png

Hello Citizens!

We told you that we'd have some exciting news for you, and last night in the Convergence Games Showcase we were pleased to announce that Karma: The Dark World is coming to Steam Next Fest on October 14th!

Watch our new trailer now to get glimpse of the challenges that lie ahead for you...

[previewyoutube=Z57cdTeOZVA;full][/previewyoutube]

In 17 days you will be stepping into the shoes of Daniel Mcgovern, and taking on your first investigation as a Roam Agent, diving into the mind of an employee accused by Leviathan of treason - and tasked with finding the truth.

But how much of this is real? How reliable is the mind of a man broken by Leviathans iron fist? And should what lurks in the shadows of those memories be seen by anyone at all?

We'll leave that for you to decide...

Once more, thank you for all your support - and the team wishes you a productive, and wonderful weekend. Be sure to [strike]submit your bluebottle request forms[/strike] wishlist the game and share with your friends! And follow us on our socials below.

notes.title: KARMA: The Dark World - Hope | Hope(less)
notes.content:
Karma: The Dark World took OVER 2024's Summer Game Fest in LA! With two brand new trailers dropping during the Day of Devs and IGN live - plus media and specially invited guests being able to go hand on during Geoff Keighley's Play Days event and the Guerrilla Collective! Dropping two trailers for one game isn't easy - believe us, but we wanted to really showcase the world that Karma breaths in, and make gamers ask questions about the Leviathan Corporation and their Bureau of Thought. Releasing as two parts, each trailer is a mirror inverse of the other. Leviathan claims to have your best interests at heart, they say they are your friend, but is everything they profess to be true really what it seems?

Watch the Karma: The Dark World "Hope" Trailer
[previewyoutube=a36idLkDemQ;full]https://youtu.be/a36idLkDemQ [/previewyoutube]
Watch the Karma: The Dark World "Hope(less)" Trailer
[previewyoutube=ag6znBto8hc;full][/previewyoutube]

Psychological thriller KARMA: The Dark World, created by groundbreaking Chinese developer, Pollard Studio, was announced as part of Wired Direct ‘24. This visionary new title explores what is possible in narrative design and technology, featuring mind-bending concepts with next-generation visuals, crafting a true cinematic masterpiece.

The setting? East Germany, 1984. In a dystopian world ruled by the Leviathan Corporation. KARMA takes players deep into a world where twisted creations linger just out of sight, and where every shadow holds a secret. 

Discover the truth in a dark story of love, loss and deception.

KARMA: The Dark World is meticulously crafted in Unreal Engine 5 and will be coming soon to PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox. You can wishlist Karma: The Dark World on Steam, GOG, Epic, and PlayStation now. Follow the game on Xbox store too.

notes.title: ‘The Dark World: KARMA’Announced
notes.content:
Greeting everyone!
We are Pollard Studio, an indie development studio based in Shanghai, China.  It is both exciting and nervous to unveil KARMA on Steam Store, which is a milestone for us. We are determined to make the best KARMA, and we hope to have more support from you, our dear players.

KARMA is a story-driven first-person horror game. In the game, you will act as an investigator and step into a dark and gloomy world to regain memory. The game tribute to "1984" by George Orwell and "Two Peaks" by David Lynch, strive to bring a freaky and surreal world to the players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963499/7344833f1f1fa75b257f5ac9a818c85947edd2e9.jpg

The game is under development and expected to be finished in Q2 or Q3 in 2022. Please follow us on Facebook, Twitter and join our Discord for the following information. We are looking forward to your support by adding KARMA to the wishlist.
